proof_body:
by
  intro f hf
  refine MeasureTheory.continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun v => ‖f v‖) ?_ ?_ hf.norm ?_
  · intro w
    refine MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.mul ?_ hf.aestronglyMeasurable
    exact (by fun_prop : Continuous fun v : ℝ => Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · intro w
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
  · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun v => ?_)
    fun_prop
target_source: ∀ f : ℝ → ℂ, MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume → Continuous (fun w : ℝ => ∫ v : ℝ, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * v * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * f v)
